messages:
Jordan: Morning team — kicking off Oakbridge onboarding. They signed yesterday and want production inference in a private VPC, 2-week pilot then GA. Key stakeholders: Riley (Oakbridge TPM) and Priya C. from infra. Can we align on success criteria and a rough timeline?
Priya: Congrats! quick Q — do we have signed DPA + network contacts?
Jordan: DPA is done. Riley sent network contacts, but we need to confirm CIDR and proxy rules. Riley pasted a spreadsheet link earlier: https://oakbridge.example.com/netmap (they gave access).
Ethan: I'll take network checklist and initial infra readout. ETA EOD today to outline required ports and cert plan.
Sam: I'll scope the onboarding runbook (VPC peering, KMS, test dataset flow). Will drop a draft in this thread by tomorrow.
Jordan: Success criteria proposal: 1) Private VPC connection established, 2) Sample inference pipeline with <150ms median p99 for 1 token on their target model within pilot capacity, 3) Basic RBAC + audit logs enabled, 4) Eval harness for 10 canonical prompts passing smoke tests. Thoughts?
Priya: Agree with those. Add: we need a renewal-risk flag — if their eval quality regresses >5% vs baseline, trigger escalation.
Ethan: Noted. For perf target: need to confirm model size and seq lengths — Riley, can you confirm anticipated peak sequence length and model family?
Riley (Oakbridge): Riley: We'll start with a Llama-2-13b equivalent, mostly customer support prompts ~512 tokens. Peak qps ~30.
Jordan: Perfect. Timeline draft: Day 0-2: infra config + certs; Day 3-5: VPC peering + private endpoints; Day 6-9: deploy model variant + perf tuning; Day 10-13: run evals + enablement; Day 14: pilot review + go/no-go for GA.
Sam: I can parallelize runbook tasks during perf tuning. Also recommend a canary route for rollback — simple traffic split 90/10.
Ethan: I'll prepare a quantization / batching recommendation doc to keep cost below their committed budget.
Jordan: Ownerships: Jordan (CSM) — stakeholder comms & success criteria; Priya — compliance + DPA checks; Ethan — infra & perf; Sam — runbook + enablement docs.
Priya: Capture feedback cadence: weekly sync + short async report on infra & cost each Wed. Add a post-pilot NPS + technical retrospective with eng.
Jordan: Risks: network delays, model quality drift, and their internal sign-off delays. Mitigation: pre-signed network windows, early evals on synthetic data, and a success checklist for their sign-off.
Ethan: I'll add automated synthetic-run scripts to the repo. Quick snippet I’ll use:
```bash
# run 100 warmup requests
python run_load.py --model candidate --qps 5 --seq 256 --requests 100
```
Jordan: Nice. Customer enablement: Sam to prepare 60-min enablement session + a 1-pager (runbook summary). Riley, what times work for your team next week?
Riley (Oakbridge): Riley: Tue 10am PT works for the enablement session.
Jordan: Booked. I'll send calendar invite and pre-read (runbook + performance targets).
Priya: Reminders: ensure KMS key policy includes their security team, and request audit log retention requirement (how long do they need logs?).
Riley (Oakbridge): Riley: 1 year retention please. Also, can we have a shared Slack channel for faster triage during pilot?
Jordan: Good call — creating #oakbridge-onboard now and inviting respective folks.
eng-bot: Channel #oakbridge-onboard created by Jordan at 2026-03-21 10:12:03 :rocket:
Jordan: Next steps summary (will DM owners): - Ethan: infra checklist + perf doc by EOD today - Sam: runbook draft by tomorrow - Priya: compliance & log retention confirmation by EOD tomorrow - Jordan: calendar + Slack channel + success criteria doc by EOD.
Priya: I'll also capture renewal-risk note in Gainsight with the 5% quality threshold and escalation path.
Jordan: Thanks all — let's aim for that Tuesday enablement and a pilot readiness check on Day 12. :thumbsup:
Ethan: On it.
Sam: Will post the runbook link once ready.
Riley (Oakbridge): Riley: Thanks everyone, excited to get started!
